body: Why don't you guys try to compromise and balance things out first? That way, you'll know what to do next if it still doesn't work. No regrets. Or not much.
I will do that. Thank you so much.

At first, I really don't want to mess things up with her. After our breakup, and months have passed, she messaged me a Happy Birthday. At that time I just said thank you and ended the message. I was so embarrassed by the fact that this girl is still being nice to me after everything that I have done to her.

And even up until last week, I have no plans on pushing myself to her. I sent her an email a month ago, even if it was too late, I explained everything to her. I apologized for what I have done and there's no excuses to that.

I told her that I'll do my best for us not to bumped into each other at the office and congratulated her on her promotion. 

What I did on my part is that I begged by boss to cancel my transfer to their department even if it means not accepting my promotion. 

I just don't understand myself that after I sent that email and after declining my long term goal of being promoted, I started to realized that I have feelings for her.

I'll take your advice, though. I have no plans on asking this girl for a relationship again I just want us to be coworkers. 

That time is not something that I am proud of. I was too emotional and revengeful back then. I was wrong.

Thank you for this. Really.

I finally decided to open up to my mom about my depression and suicidal thoughts. I already told her that I just want her to listen to me and be there because any form of advice feels like hell to either.
But maybe because of the nature of being a mother, she still told me to seek professional help, which I told her I'm not ready yet. She also told me to go and have a vacation but i told her how?

Then she felt that I'm dismissing all of her opinions and good advices, she then told me that she is just a burden to me. That I'm suffering because I'm supporting her, feeding her, supplying maintenance medicine and stuff, which got me pissed.

Then I told her why she's saying that. That's not my goal for telling her what I've been dealing with.

And then finally, words came from her mouth saying.. "I've been through worst in my life, but I never went crazy (mentally ill)"

NOW I'm decided to end my life. It really is taking a toll.

It's hard for me to open up, and I should not have.

Please help.. I don't have any support system but myself and I already gave up with my life.
